config.notes: Agent evals are descriptive; the authoritative correctness gate is the offline deterministic suite (python evals/run_evals.py).

evals.name: deliveryline-sa-golden-forecast
evals.prompt: Forecast the first-run cluster for Deliveryline SA: 1.85 TB daily high-criticality Delta upsert with six merge keys, eight joins, partitioned source, no merge partition pruning, analog and pricing supplied.
evals.expected_output: Classifies merge_heavy, recommends an E-series memory-optimized multi-worker Photon job cluster, emits lean/recommended/conservative options and a bounded non-trivial cost projection.

assertions.text: recommended node is memory optimized E-series and Photon is enabled
three tiers and cost band are present

evals.name: small-append-simple-etl
evals.prompt: Forecast a tiny append-only ETL under 1 GB with no merge and no joins.
evals.expected_output: Classifies simple_etl and recommends the smallest single-node general-purpose D/DS cluster with low cost and no Photon.

evals.name: join-heavy-sort-merge
evals.prompt: Forecast two large facts joined by sort-merge joins with no merge.
evals.expected_output: Classifies join_heavy, enables Photon, uses a memory/general multi-worker node and large shuffle partitions.

evals.name: abstain-unreadable-sources
evals.prompt: Forecast a job where the source table reports size_bytes=0.
evals.expected_output: Abstains with reasons and emits no guessed recommended_cluster.
